description: This file defines the GrainType struct which represents the type of a grain in the Orleans framework. It includes constructors, methods for serialization, conversion operators, equality comparisons, and string formatting.

classes.name: GrainType
classes.description: Immutable struct representing the type of a grain, supporting serialization, comparison, and string formatting.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new GrainType instance from a string value, encoding it as UTF8 bytes.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another GrainType instance.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code of the underlying IdSpan.

methods.name: GetUniformHashCode
methods.description: Returns a uniform, stable hash code for the grain type.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the grain type, decoding the value as UTF8.

methods.name: CompareTo
methods.description: Compares this GrainType to another for ordering.
